stemMd: What does “retrieval” mean in the passage?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Translating every document into one foreign language.

explanationMd: The archive’s purpose is not just storage but enabling users to find relevant records. “Retrieval” names this locating and accessing process. It is separate from creating or destroying the underlying documents.

distractorRationale.e: The context concerns searches and files.
distractorRationale.b: The vocabulary work connects descriptions without requiring that process.
